map.🧮 药酒浸泡浓度 / 时间计算: 🧮 Medicinal Wine Steeping Concentration / Time Calculator
map.输入药材类别、药材重量、白酒体积与酒精度，估算生药浓度、浸出物浓度、建议浸泡时间: Enter the herb category, herb weight, liquor volume and alcohol strength to estimate the crude drug concentration, extract concentration, suggested steeping time and dosing, and back-calculate the amount for a target concentration.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：dose×2: Core formulas (from the input variables): dose*2
map.根茎类（人参、黄芪等）: Roots and rhizomes (such as ginseng, astragalus)
map.果实种子类（枸杞、五味子等）: Fruits and seeds (such as goji, schisandra)
map.动物类（鹿茸、蛤蚧等）: Animal materials (such as deer antler, gecko)
map.目标生药浓度 (g/mL，可空): Target crude drug concentration (g/mL, may be blank)
map.💡 生药浓度 = 药材重量 ÷ 白酒体积（g/mL）；浸出物浓度 = 药材重量: 💡 Crude drug concentration = herb weight / liquor volume (g/mL); extract concentration = herb weight x extraction rate / volume; the suggested steeping time depends on the herb category; the usual dose is 15 to 30 mL each time, 1 to 2 times per day.
map.药酒含乙醇，服用应遵医嘱，孕妇、儿童及肝病患者忌服: Medicinal wine contains ethanol, so take it as directed by a physician; it is contraindicated for pregnant women, children and liver disease patients
map.浸出率为经验值（约 15%~30%），实际因药材、粉碎度、酒精度而异: The extraction rate is an empirical value (about 15% to 30%) and actually varies with the herb, the degree of comminution and the alcohol strength
map.本工具仅供配方设计参考，不作为医疗依据；纯前端运行，数据不上传: This tool is for formula design reference only and is not a medical basis; it runs entirely in the front end and uploads no data
map.📚 深度解析：药酒浓度/浸出量/单次服量计算: 📚 In-depth analysis: medicinal wine concentration / extract amount / single dose calculation
map.生药-酒比例设计: Crude drug to wine ratio design
map.herb 100g + vol 1000mL → conc=100/1000=0: herb 100 g + vol 1000 mL gives conc = 100/1000 = 0.1 g/mL and ratio 1:10; for a flower/leaf category with p.rate about 0.105 the extract = 10.5 g and extConc = 10.5 mg/mL; a concentration of 0.1 triggers dose = 15 mL per time.
map.生成浓度 0.05 < 目标 0.1 → 判不达标；需增设药材至 200g，或减: The generated concentration 0.05 is below the target 0.1, so it fails; either increase the herb to 200 g or reduce the liquor to 500 mL, and a concentration of 0.2 triggers dose = 10 mL per time, which works out to 1.5 g of crude drug per dose.
map.dose 与 conc 关系？: How does dose relate to concentration?
map.dose=20mL(conc<0.1)、15mL(0.1≤conc<0.2)、1: dose = 20 mL (conc below 0.1), 15 mL (0.1 <= conc < 0.2), 10 mL (conc 0.2 or above); this keeps the crude drug in one dose under 1.5 to 2 g so a single intake never takes in too much active component.
map.每日饮量怎么定？: How is the daily amount set?
map.常规药酒每次 10–15 mL、每日 1–2 次，且需从最小量开始、观察耐受后调: A routine medicinal wine is 10-15 mL each time, 1-2 times per day, and you should start from the smallest amount and adjust after observing tolerance; therapeutic medicinal wines (containing toxic herbs) must have the dose set by a physician and must not be self-dosed at the usual tonic wine amount. Note that concentration here means the grams of crude drug per mL of liquor, which is different from the alcohol strength; it is contraindicated in abnormal liver function, pregnancy, children, and people taking cephalosporins or hypoglycemic drugs.
